neighbours.label: reassuring word after a stated drawback (still worth it, not a big deal, don't worry, on the bright side)
fire: The hotel room was small and a bit noisy. It was still worth the price for the location.
They forgot the extra sauce with my order. Not a big deal, the burger was great anyway.
The app crashed twice during setup. Don't worry, your files were saved automatically.
Our flight was delayed four hours. On the bright side, we got free lunch vouchers.
The cake sank a little in the middle, but it tasted just as delicious as always.
The printer jams sometimes. Fortunately, a quick restart fixes it every time.
One of the disks failed overnight. Enough backups exist that nothing was lost.
The hike was longer than we planned, but the view was still worth every step.
